Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

Subs and their routes, supplies, parts, retainers, Free Companies, inventories, income, the market and trends, all in the game. Keep your fleet on this PC with nothing else to install, or share it between PCs (and with the free Windows app) through a database. Type /xivfleet to start.

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
Simpler for new players: one clear way to do each thing, and nothing they don't need.

- "Everything on this PC" is gone from Set up this PC. It installed a whole PostgreSQL database for one PC, which Keep it on this PC does with one file and nothing to install. Set up this PC now says so. A database already set up that way keeps working.
- With Just this PC, Database tools don't offer database setup. They say there's nothing to set up, and that Move your fleet switches to a shared database.
- The "Use a shared database" card now says to set the database up in Settings → Database tools, not with the app.
- One database connection in Settings, instead of a Local / Remote switch between two. The one in use stays (or the other, if only that one was saved).
- Account Label is optional with one account. Settings mentions it quietly; the Status page warns only once more than one setup syncs the fleet.
- FC Tracker's settings file is only shown when it's needed (FC Tracker running but not answering directly, and its file not found).
- Fight Club Data has a link to Fight Club's spreadsheet, and says how to save it for the import.
- The speed test from 2.0's testing is out of the sidebar and the Status page (/xivfleet speedtest still works).
- Plainer labels: "Sync this game's fleet", "Sync every (minutes)", and Address, Login, Save and "Forget the saved connection" for the database connection.
- Clearer names on the pages, the same as the app's: the Subs page's Craft? is now Fight Club builds (ticked: from rank 85 the sub follows Fight Club's best build), Roster is Character Roster, and "setup" is now "game" (as in "synced by another game"). Column names are written one way throughout (Next build, Target route, Quantity).
- No more messages about old app versions: the plugin keeps the database up to date itself, and says so. Plainer hover text for the backup tools and the fleet file check.
- Moving your fleet no longer refuses a good move at random. A time just under half a millisecond could compare as different after copying (the move was refused and nothing changed).
